input_packet_dtype: fp64 validated from every NPZ array; no implicit widening

runtime_config.arms_execution: sequential; each arm may use workers_per_arm independent chunk processes
runtime_config.call: one value-only kdm6_fn FnResult per request
runtime_config.chunking: fixed prepared flat-column order, 512 columns except final 452-column chunk
runtime_config.factor_mode_environment: KDM6_ICE_FACTORIAL_MODE set to the arm name
runtime_config.trace_environment: KDM6_ICE_BOUNDARY_TRACE, KDM6_SUBSTEP_DUMP and KDM6_SAME_CALL_BUDGET_TRACE cleared unless explicitly overridden
